desc_short: Nissan Stadium: riverfront football bowl with navy blue seats and red bands between tiers, tall sideline decks, steel light towers on both sideline rims, green field
Lincoln Financial Field: football stadium with dark midnight green seats, curved wing-shaped canopy roofs over both sideline stands, open ends, dark steel and glass exterior, green field
State Farm Stadium: oval domed stadium clad in silver-white ribbed metal panels with vertical slots of dark glass, a long retractable roof panel in the center, low profile
Neyland Stadium: huge closed college football bowl with orange and white checkered end zones, gray concrete stands, tall press box tower on one sideline, green field
Target Field: tan limestone ballpark with dark green seats, a white canopy over the upper deck, large left field scoreboard, tight downtown site
Rate Field: steel and concrete ballpark with dark green seats, a flat canopy roof over the upper deck, scoreboard with pinwheels in center field, grass field
Raymond James Stadium: football stadium with bright red seats, a large pirate ship in the north end zone stands, tall sideline press box, light concrete exterior, green field
Chase Center: round arena with a white rounded drum, a band of glass at the base, a flat white roof, a large glass atrium entrance at one side
Comerica Park: tan brick ballpark with dark green seats, open outfield with a center field fountain, large left field scoreboard, grass field
CEFCU Stadium San Jose: compact college football stadium with blue and gold accents, two tall sideline grandstands, open ends with low seating, green field
